page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, one main text column on the right, marginal notes in the left margin, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: absolutissima, at nostra non sunt; sunt opera; at nimium debita sunt. Si vero debita Deo, quæ nobis inde merces debetur transcendentis gloriæ; Ecce nos & serui, & inutiles: ἀχρεῖοι inquit Deus; sunt condigna, regerunt Pontificij: Ephes.2.Gratia seruati estis per fidem, idque non ex vobis (inquit Deus.) Gratia quidem, sed tamen ex nobismet, Pontificij. Quæ hæc insolentia est? Accersant nunc sibi scilicet vltroneam paupertatem monachi; qui spirituales diuitias, supra quod Ezekias suos auri acer-uos, tam nimium ostentant. Hier. Epitaph. Fabiola.Verè Hieronymus, Difficilius

page.notes: The Greek word after "inquit" is printed as ἀχρεῖοι-like letters, partly illegible in the scan; transcribed as best read. Left margin notes: "Ephes.2." and "Hier. Epitaph. Fabiola." The catchword "arro-" is a hyphenated word-start at the foot.
